questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The quality of being brave"
questions.explanation: The word is "bravery": the quality of courage in the face of danger. Do not confuse it with "bravado": a show of boldness meant to impress.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The state of being a slave"
questions.explanation: The word is "slavery": the state of being owned by another and forced to labour. Do not confuse it with "slavishness": excessive servility in character.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The state of being a child"
questions.explanation: The word is "childhood": the period or state of being a child. Do not confuse it with "boyhood": the period of being a boy only.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The quality of being honest"
questions.explanation: The word is "honesty": truthfulness and freedom from deceit. Do not confuse it with "honour": high respect or good name.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The state of being a widow"
questions.explanation: The word is "widowhood": the condition of a woman whose husband has died. Do not confuse it with "spinsterhood": the state of being an unmarried woman.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The quality of being generous"
questions.explanation: The word is "generosity": willingness to give freely. Do not confuse it with "geniality": friendly cheerfulness.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The state of being free from all trouble and anxiety"
questions.explanation: The word is "serenity": a state of calm and peace. Do not confuse it with "solitude": the state of being alone.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "Strong dislike or ill will towards another"
questions.explanation: The word is "hatred": intense dislike or ill will. Do not confuse it with "anger": a feeling of strong annoyance.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The quality of being wise"
questions.explanation: The word is "wisdom": good judgement based on knowledge and experience. Do not confuse it with "wit": quick and inventive humour.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The state of being poor"
questions.explanation: The word is "poverty": the state of lacking money and basic necessities. Do not confuse it with "prosperity": a state of wealth and success.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The quality of being proud of oneself in an excessive manner"
questions.explanation: The word is "arrogance": an offensive display of superiority. Do not confuse it with "ambition": a strong desire to achieve something.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The quality of being thankful"
questions.explanation: The word is "gratitude": the quality of being thankful. Do not confuse it with "gratuity": a sum of money paid on retirement or a tip.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The state of being friends with someone"
questions.explanation: The word is "friendship": the bond or state of being friends. Do not confuse it with "friction": conflict or rubbing between persons or surfaces.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The quality of being able to do something well"
questions.explanation: The word is "ability": the power or skill to do something. Do not confuse it with "agility": quickness and ease of movement.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The state of being an adult male"
questions.explanation: The word is "manhood": the state of being an adult male. Do not confuse it with "mankind": the human race as a whole.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The quality of being kind and gentle to those in distress"
questions.explanation: The word is "compassion": sympathy and concern for the sufferings of others. Do not confuse it with "compulsion": a force that compels one to act.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The condition of being healthy"
questions.explanation: The word is "health": the state of being free from illness. Do not confuse it with "wealth": abundance of money or possessions.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The feeling of discontent at another's good fortune"
questions.explanation: The word is "envy": resentful longing for what another has. Do not confuse it with "pride": sorrow felt for the suffering of others.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The habit of avoiding spending or giving too much money"
questions.explanation: The word is "thrift": careful and economical use of money. Do not confuse it with "theft": the act of stealing.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The state of being a member of a club or society"
questions.explanation: The word is "membership": the state of belonging to a group or society. Do not confuse it with "friendship": the bond between friends.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The quality of being loyal to a person or cause"
questions.explanation: The word is "loyalty": firm and constant support or allegiance. Do not confuse it with "royalty": the status of a king or queen.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The state of having no money to pay one's debts"
questions.explanation: The word is "bankruptcy": the legal state of being unable to pay one's debts. Do not confuse it with "poverty": the state of having very little money, not necessarily owing debts.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The quality of being modest and not proud"
questions.explanation: The word is "humility": a modest view of one's own importance. Do not confuse it with "humour": the quality of being amusing.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The quality of being very careful to avoid risk or error"
questions.explanation: The word is "caution": care taken to avoid danger or mistakes. Do not confuse it with "cowardice": lack of courage in the face of danger.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The quality of being punctual"
questions.explanation: The word is "punctuality": the habit of being on time. Do not confuse it with "perseverance": steady effort despite difficulties.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The state of being able to bear pain or delay calmly"
questions.explanation: The word is "patience": the capacity to endure delay or hardship calmly. Do not confuse it with "patronage": support given by a patron.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The legal status of being a citizen of a country"
questions.explanation: The word is "citizenship": the legal status of being a citizen. Do not confuse it with "citation": an official quotation or a mention for bravery.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The act of telling a lie under oath in a court of law"
questions.explanation: The word is "perjury": deliberately telling an untruth after taking an oath. Do not confuse it with "forgery": the act of making a false document.

questions.questionText: Choose the one word that can replace the phrase: "The state of being dependent on a drug or habit"
questions.explanation: The word is "addiction": compulsive dependence on a substance or activity. Do not confuse it with "affliction": a condition of suffering or distress.

questions.questionText: Select the single word that best substitutes for: "The strong desire to possess more than one needs"
questions.explanation: The word is "greed": intense selfish desire for wealth or possessions. Do not confuse it with "grief": deep sorrow, especially at a loss.

questions.questionText: Pick the one word that stands for: "The state of being exact and free from error"
questions.explanation: The word is "accuracy": exactness and freedom from error. Do not confuse it with "agility": quickness and ease of movement.

questions.questionText: Which one word can be used in place of the phrase: "The state of perfect happiness"
questions.explanation: The word is "bliss": perfect happiness; great joy. Do not confuse it with "bias": an unfair leaning towards one side.
